entries.zh: 楼上的窗户朝着一个安静的庭院。

entries.en: He cannot afford a bicycle, not to mention a car.
entries.zh: 他连自行车都买不起，更不用提汽车了。

entries.en: The box contains buttons, ribbons, needles, and so on.
entries.zh: 盒子里装着纽扣、丝带、针等等。

entries.en: A rubbernecker stopped beside the unusual sculpture to stare.
entries.zh: 一个看热闹的人停在那座奇特的雕塑旁，盯着看。

entries.en: The teacher struggled with the unruliness of the excited class.
entries.zh: 老师费力地应付着全班兴奋而不守纪律的状态。

entries.en: The tiny rented room was meagerly furnished.
entries.zh: 那间狭小的出租屋陈设很简陋。

entries.en: We call on residents to share their views on the park.
entries.zh: 我们呼吁居民分享对这座公园的看法。

entries.en: Let us look at the cost before choosing a design.
entries.zh: 选择设计方案前，让我们先考虑费用。

entries.en: I do work for a local publisher during the holidays.
entries.zh: 假期里我为一家当地出版社工作。

entries.en: Several delegates threatened to walk out of the meeting in protest.
entries.zh: 几位代表威胁要走出会场以示抗议。

entries.en: May I try on the green jacket by the window?
entries.zh: 我可以试穿一下窗边那件绿色夹克吗？

entries.en: The trust releases the funds when the beneficiaries come of age.
entries.zh: 受益人成年时，信托会发放这笔资金。
